{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the contract premises
print('Total rows:', len(df))
print('Unique patient_id count:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Number of duplicate patient_id entries:', (df['patient_id'].duplicated()).sum())
print('Max sample_seq:', df['sample_seq'].max())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('\nSentinel value (-999) count in biomarker_baseline:', (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Confirm that patient_id is indeed the patient identifier
print('\nFirst few patient_id values:', df['patient_id'].head(10).tolist())

# Check if sample_seq > 1 implies re-test
print('\nHow many patients have multiple sample_seq entries?')
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
print('Patients with more than one sample_seq:', (df_grouped > 1).sum())"}
